TYPE: art
SUBJECT: Digital-art collage in which a translucent Guy Fawkes mask floats in the upper left over a blue steel truss bridge, its arch framing a clear view of the Empire State Building and Manhattan brick buildings under a partly cloudy sky; aged newspaper headlines are layered across the upper scene like a ghostly overlay, and a black swan with a red eye dominates the lower right foreground, with green foliage edging the left side.
TEXT: IN PANIC AS STOCKS CR... / Made to Kill Italy's Crown Prince / Fire Films / E Millions / FIRM 62 PER / IN LAKE / THE PLANE / High Duty Group Gave $700,000 to Coolidge Drive / FOR MORE LOBBYISTS / More Lobbying In The Veteran's Wall
SYMBOLS: bridge, numbers

TYPE: photo
SUBJECT: Close-up of a gray flying-wing stealth bomber nose parked inside a hangar, showing its long knifelike chine, dark tinted cockpit windows, and a small red unit marking above the canopy; a white ground-support stand with cables and small illegible lettering sits beneath the nose against a plain hangar wall.
TEXT: NONE
SYMBOLS: NONE

TYPE: art
SUBJECT: Vintage black-and-white political cartoon: a lanky caricature of Uncle Sam with goatee and striped trousers stands at the left edge of a wireframe globe labeled Western Hemisphere, while an oversized star-spangled hat sits planted in the middle of the Americas carrying a two-line caption about European immigrants; on the right, a group of caricatured European men including a plump gentleman with an umbrella and a top-hatted figure stand atop a second globe looking on under crosshatched clouds.
TEXT: WESTERN HEMISPHERE / EUROPE IMMIGRANTS (caption on the hat, partially legible)
SYMBOLS: NONE

TYPE: other
SUBJECT: Glossy crypto-hype graphic overlaying an American flag with a giant dimensional chrome number 47 in the center, surrounded by glowing green candlestick charts and bar graphs rising along the bottom and right; ticker-style numbers float across the field, and the Ripple logo with XRP wordmarks sits in the lower center; the garbled digit clusters give it a machine-generated look.
TEXT: 47 / 44.457 / 47.86 / 40510 (garbled) / CH 5 / 4P / RIPPLE / XRP / 4.5.6 / 4...5.7 / 4.8.8
SYMBOLS: numbers

TYPE: photo
SUBJECT: Monochrome night photograph of a monumental Beaux-Arts rail terminal with a tall tower and a columned, arched-window concourse, floodlit white against a black sky, with the giant stencil-style letters ISO 20022 superimposed across the tower facade; streetlamps, bare trees, picnic benches and temporary fencing line the dark grass and pavement of the foreground plaza.
TEXT: ISO 20022
SYMBOLS: numbers

TYPE: photo
SUBJECT: Studio close-up against a pure black background of an incandescent light bulb with its glass envelope shattered open, the jagged rim broken away and the wire filament supports exposed, a faint orange glow at the base, while long curling wisps of white smoke drift upward through the darkness from the broken glass.
TEXT: NONE
SYMBOLS: NONE

TYPE: other
SUBJECT: Sleek futuristic render of a white sci-fi medical bay centered on a sculpted pod-style hospital bed with a curved gray body, glowing underlight striping, and a made-up pillow and blanket; the hull reads QUANTUM and EON-H6, an illuminated wall sign above says MED BED, and a bedside monitor shows a heartbeat waveform with vital-sign digits; the glossy reflective floor and garbled screen lettering mark it as machine-generated concept art.
TEXT: MED BED / EON-H6 / QUANTUM / 17 131 37 / small garbled screen text throughout
SYMBOLS: numbers

TYPE: photo
SUBJECT: Moody, desaturated photograph of damaged highway signs leaning over dry grass beside a rural two-lane road under heavy gray storm clouds: a diamond-shaped route marker numbered 751 with a small arrow placard below it, a large green exit sign tilted sharply and reading only EXI with a bent white arrow, and a separate green placard on its own leaning post bearing just the lone letter T; bare leafless trees line the road where a few cars pass.
TEXT: 751 / EXI / T
SYMBOLS: numbers

TYPE: photo
SUBJECT: Courtroom scene in which a frail elderly woman with wispy white hair, wearing a light blue hospital gown, stands at a varnished wooden podium with steel handcuffs on her wrists and her hands clasped; behind and above her a Black judge in black robes bows his head gravely, a partially visible court seal arcs over his shoulders, an American flag hangs at the left, and the tan shoulder of a uniformed deputy edges into the frame; the smoothed texture suggests a generated or heavily processed image.
TEXT: USTICE (partial arc lettering on the court seal)
SYMBOLS: NONE

TYPE: photo
SUBJECT: A cylindrical, horizontally ribbed lantern lamp glowing intense green hangs from a dark overhead structure, its fresnel-style lens emitting a bright emerald core that washes the surrounding beams and casts broad horizontal bands of green light across the flat surface below, with everything beyond the lamp's reach swallowed in near-total darkness.
TEXT: NONE
